verdict.rationale: There is indirect support only. Contacts carry properties that workflows can reference (telli-docs-5), the REST API manages contacts and schedules calls (telli-docs-12, telli-docs-17), and custom tools let agents pull external information from your APIs during a call (telli-docs-20). Together these suggest a way to supply per-caller context, but nothing documents injecting variables into the agent's prompt or conversation at call time. Missing for 10: documented dynamic or template variables in agent prompts, a schedule-call parameter for passing per-call context, examples of contact properties personalizing the conversation, and independent corroboration.
